# Usman Hassan

## About

Software engineer building mobile and web products with React Native, Expo and Next.js.

I build mobile and web products, and work across the APIs and infrastructure behind them. I started as a web developer in 2021 and won my first hackathon a year later with a mobile app.

I've been the sole mobile developer behind Scrim and Goalr, led front-end development at Brimble, and shipped mobile and web products at Chimoney and Yusra. More recently, I've built Silo and Kodo. At GenzTechies, I build community tools, mentor developers and help organize hackathons.

## Work

- **GenzTechies** — Software engineering lead (Aug 2022 – Now). Build the community's web applications, mentor developers and help organize hackathons.
- **Brimble** — Software engineer (Aug 2022 – Early 2025). Led front-end development for Brimble, a web hosting platform. Built the interface, authentication and validation flows, and integrations with GitHub, Google and Firebase.
- **Yusra** — Software engineer (Mar 2024 – Dec 2024). Full-stack engineer on Yusra, a brand-wallet shopping and rewards app. Built and shipped both the mobile app (React Native & Expo) and the web application.
- **Terrahaptix** — Hardware engineering intern (Sep 2024 – Dec 2024). Interned as a hardware engineer, learning the intricate workings of hardware devices and drone technology, building and maintaining drones.
- **Chimoney** — Full-stack developer (Mar 2024 – Jun 2024). Built payments, wallets and payouts features across Chimoney's mobile and web apps, shipping iteratively in an agile team.
- **Goalr** — Mobile developer (Jul 2023 – Mar 2024). Sole mobile developer at Goalr, a fitness app that syncs Apple Health, Strava, Garmin and Google Fit. Designed, built and released the app end-to-end on a tight timeline.
- **Aviato** — Backend Engineer (2023 – 2024).
- **Scrim** — Mobile developer (2022 – 2023). Sole mobile developer for Scrim, a rewards and payments app. Built the app with React Native (Expo) and TypeScript, including wallets, biometric authentication, secure storage, push notifications and OTA updates. Shipped to iOS and Android, and contributed to the web app and API integrations. The app lives on as the Chimoney app.
- **EarlyBean** — Mobile app developer (Aug 2022 – Mar 2023). Sole mobile developer for a finance app that helps families teach children about money. Worked on the interface and business logic.
- **Cykmore** — Front-end engineer (Aug 2022 – Jan 2023). Built front-end features with Vue.js and Nuxt.js for a recruitment technology company, working alongside other developers.
- **BuildBrothers** — Software engineer intern (2021 – 2022). Started my career at BuildBrothers' BuildSpace hub, building web applications and learning production software development.

## Projects

### Goalr (2023 – 2024)

[Goalr](https://goalr.world): A fitness app that brings walks, runs and rides into one place.
Built with: React Native, Expo, TypeScript.
Responsibility: I was the sole mobile developer, responsible for the app from its interface through to release.
Implementation: Integrated Apple Health, Strava, Garmin and Google Fit so the app could sync activity from different services.
Delivery: Designed, built and released the app to the App Store and Google Play on a tight timeline.
On the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goalr-walk-run-ride-earn/id6465899289) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.goalr).

### Scrim (2022 – 2023)

[Scrim](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.usescrim.app): A rewards and payments app for earning as you spend, swapping crypto and sending transfers by email or phone.
Built with: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Firebase, Reanimated.
Responsibility: Built the mobile app from the ground up as the sole mobile developer, covering the interface and business logic.
Implementation: Connected wallet and payment flows with biometric authentication, secure storage, push notifications and over-the-air updates. I also contributed to the web app and API integrations.
Delivery: Shipped to iOS and Android. The original Google Play listing now belongs to the Chimoney app.

### Yusra (2024)

[Yusra](https://yusra.app): A wallet for every brand: discover stores, earn rewards, save and shop.
Built with: React Native, Expo, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Supabase.
Responsibility: Worked full-stack across both the mobile app and the web application.
Implementation: Built the mobile product with React Native and Expo, and the browser experience with Next.js. The product covers store discovery, brand wallets, rewards and shopping.
Delivery: Built and shipped both surfaces rather than working on only one client.

### Brimble (2022 – 2025)

[Brimble](https://brimble.io): A platform for shipping modern websites and applications. Led the front-end implementation, including authentication, validation and third-party integrations.
Built with: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.

### GenzTechies (2023)

[GenzTechies](https://genztechies.com): Web applications for a community of young people working in technology.
Built with: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Tailwind CSS.

### Silo (2025 – 2026)

[Silo](https://silo.ng): A mobile-first personal finance app with transaction intelligence, fund locking, group savings and bill splitting.
Built with: React Native, Expo, TypeScript, Zustand, Tailwind CSS.

### Kodo (2025 – 2026)

[Kodo](https://kodo.codes): A developer productivity and session tracking platform spanning mobile, web and IDE extensions.
Built with: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, Next.js.

### Penter (2023 – 2024)

[Penter](https://penter.xyz): A design tool that turns CSV or JSON data into dynamic designs using text, images and colours.
Built with: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Tailwind CSS.

### WhoDeySell (2021 – 2022)

[WhoDeySell](https://whodeysell.com.ng): A local marketplace with price discovery and a Swap-It feature for trading items. Built while at BuildBrothers.
Built with: React, Next.js, JavaScript.

## Recognition

- 1st place, GenzTechies Hackfest (Jul 2022). Won with SafePal, a mobile app for reporting missing persons that uses consent-based location tracking to give security agencies the data they need to find them.
- Core organiser of GenzTechies hackathons (2023 – Now). The win brought me into the GenzTechies core community, where I've since been a core organizer of two more hackathons.
